about.header1: Trio Travel - Your Travel Agency in Zakopane for Unforgettable Trips
about.text: We know Zakopane like the back of our hand, and nothing is impossible for us!
about.text2: We have extensive experience in organizing all kinds of tourism projects, themed events, and transportation

why.header: Why is the best choice for your trip

1.text: Trio Travel is a Zakopane-based agency that knows the Tatra and Pieniny Mountains like few others. They specialize in day trips, Dunajec rafting, sleigh rides, and whitewater rafting, ensuring well-planned routes and attractions based on their deep regional experience.

2.text: From local attractions like sleigh rides to river rafting – Trio Travel offers a wide range of services in one place. It’s the perfect solution for anyone wanting to make the most of their time in the mountains.

3.text: The company focuses on tailoring its offer to the client's needs. Whether you're looking for a relaxing trip or an active adventure, Trio Travel provides the flexibility to meet your expectations.

1.text: Trio Travel is a travel agency with extensive experience in organizing all kinds of tourism projects, themed events, and transportation. We know Zakopane like the back of our hand, and nothing is impossible for us. Initially, we focused mainly on domestic and international transport, but over time, we became a tourism and transport company organizing a wide range of exciting trips, including fantastic one-day excursions.

2.text: We are registered in the Register of Tour Operators and Tourist Agents of the Marshal of the Małopolska Region under number Z/54/2013. We hold AXA travel insurance, so every trip with us is not only full of great experiences but also ensures essential safety. Our clients appreciate us for our ability to adapt to their needs, the comprehensive nature of our services, and our flexibility.

3.text: Our team is made up of creative and energetic people, which guarantees top-quality organization. We organize sleigh rides, especially the most thrilling ones – evening rides. We also offer Dunajec river rafting and many other one-day excursions. Zakopane is full of attractions we would love to show you, so with us, you’ll never be bored. We also offer the most logistically efficient local transport in and around Zakopane.

splyw-dunajcem-dluzszy.text: Przygotowaliśmy dla Państwa szereg niezwykle ciekawych atrakcji, które z pewnością uczynią czas Państwa wypoczynku szalenie interesującym i niezapomnianym. Proponowany przez nas spływ Dunajcem z Zakopanego to rewelacyjny sposób na to, aby należycie nacieszyć się pięknymi krajobrazami, a zarazem wiele zwiedzić. Flisacy umilą go Państwu fascynującymi opowieściami i legendami związanymi z rzeką oraz jej okolicami. Poza spływem na drewnianej tratwie, skąd nacieszycie Państwo oczy widokiem otaczających Pienin, oferta obejmuje również możliwość zwiedzania zamku w Niedzicy, zapory na Dunajcu czy Parku Miniatur Podhala, Orawy i Spisza.

background-list.header: Wycieczka w Pieniny: Spływ i Niedzica
background-list.header2: Podczas wycieczki w Pieniny, poza główną atrakcją, którą jest spływ na drewnianych tratwach-odwiedzisz również Niedzicę, w której do wyboru masz jedną z atrakcji:

list.1: Rejs statkiem po Jeziorze Czorsztyńskim (Podczas rejsu statkiem spacerowym będziesz mógł podziwiać zaporę wodną, ruiny zamku Czorsztyńskiego, zamek Niedzica, skansen Czorsztyński oraz przepiękny górski krajobraz). Taki rejs to przygoda, która na długo zostanie w twojej pamięci!

splyw-dunajcem-dluzszy.text2: Sezon flisacki trwa od 1 kwietnia do 31 października - świątek, piątek i niedziele. Zatem na wycieczkę zapraszamy codziennie!

reviews.text: Our happy customers agree – with Trio Travel, every journey becomes an unforgettable memory, full of comfort and perfect organization. Join the group of satisfied travelers and explore the world with peace of mind!

1.name: Maciej Partyka
1.text: A very well-organized trip to Slovakia. Great communication, a friendly driver, the itinerary was followed as planned, and the coach was comfortable.

2.name: Marlena Flis
2.text: The best trips with Trio Travel agency. This time we went for the treetop walk. Total professionalism in every way. Our driver Michał was outstanding – a great driver and guide in one. Greetings from our 10-person group from September 13!

3.name: Grzegorz Danilczuk
3.text: Well-planned and interesting trip, and the guide Michał kept sharing fun facts about the mountains and acted very professionally. I’ll definitely use this agency again!

4.name: Agata Andrus
4.text: A very enjoyable trip – the Dunajec rafting was perfectly organized and the price was great. Michał took care of us, creating a very professional and relaxed atmosphere. Highly recommend.

5.name: Marta Dymińska
5.text: Great trip, excellent organization. A coach picked us up, the driver and our guide took care of everything, clearly explaining what to do and where to go. After the rafting and sightseeing, we were dropped off right at our doorstep. I'm glad we chose the Dunajec Rafting with Trio Travel. Highly recommend! 🍀

6.name: Zuzanna Lesner
6.text: Great trip! We went with Michał on the treetop walk. There was definitely too little time at Štrbské Lake though – there should be at least 2 hours for that ☺️⛰️

7.name: Małgorzata Wodzynska
7.text: Trip on June 30 – Dunajec Rafting. Very well organized. Michał, an experienced guide, had everything under control – you could tell he loves what he does. The views were stunning, and the trip was well worth the price. RECOMMENDED 🙂

elzbiecina.text: Elżbiecina Villa – the former Korfanty residence, is a unique blend of history, design, Zakopane-style architecture, and the omnipresent Witkacy-inspired Zakopane spirit.

rentplanet.text: Innovative methods and tools are used to automate many booking processes. Thanks to this, guest service in the apartment becomes simpler, and many actions take place practically without human involvement.

nosal.text: Mornings with a view of the mountain range are a ready-made recipe for a good mood all day long. Traditional Podhale cuisine is the hallmark of our original restaurant Dym i Wiatr.

klimatyczne.text: Atmospheric Cottages are very comfortable cottages built with those in mind who are looking for a place with a warm, friendly vibe conducive to relaxation.

patryk.text: Villa “Patryk” is located in a quiet and peaceful area, with plenty of greenery and walking trails nearby that encourage active rest. We especially recommend the trail to Gubałówka, the Jan Kasprowicz trail through Bachledzki Wierch, and others.

kuligi.text: organizes one-of-a-kind sleigh rides. Zakopane is home to many charming places, including the beautiful Kościeliska Valley. Our sleigh ride experiences include many attractions such as an authentic highlander feast. Sleigh rides are available all year round. Our travel agency provides pickup by minibus from your accommodation, refreshments in a truly highlander style, and the entire event is accompanied by live music from a traditional highlander band.
kuligi.header2: Discover Zakopane from its most magical side and join us for an unforgettable sleigh ride!

transport.text: Trio Travel offers comprehensive and well-organized passenger transport services. Zakopane is not the only area we serve — we also operate throughout Poland and abroad. Our services include airport transfers, local transportation, as well as support for conferences, weddings, and all kinds of standard and non-standard requests.
transport.header2: for safe and comfortable travel. Get in touch and let’s hit the road together!
transport.text2: We do our utmost to ensure every assignment is carried out properly and meets our clients' expectations. Our team's top priorities are customer satisfaction and the highest quality of service. Our drivers are experienced professionals, delivering full reliability and the necessary skills. With years of experience in transportation, our passenger services guarantee a comfortable and safe journey. We are committed to punctuality and competitive pricing. Since every client has different needs and expectations, we always tailor our services to meet individual requirements. All of our vehicles are fully licensed and equipped for international travel, ensuring safety and comfort on every route.
